# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security reports are welcome for the [latest published PinkieSysMon release](https://github.com/Jim1537/PinkieSysMon/releases/latest) and the current source on `main`. Security fixes are focused on actively maintained code and the latest release. Backports to older releases are not guaranteed.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use the repository's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/Jim1537/PinkieSysMon/security/advisories) (**Report a vulnerability**) to contact the maintainer. Do not disclose security vulnerabilities in public Issues, Discussions, or Pull Requests.

GitHub requires at least one **Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE)** assignment for each new private report. Select the most relevant CWE in the reporting form.

Where possible, include:

- The affected release, commit, or component.
- Steps to reproduce the issue and a proof of concept.
- The potential security impact and conditions required to trigger it.
- Relevant Windows, device, or provider information, without exposing private machine data.

Do not submit passwords, tokens, private keys, private dashboards, or other sensitive material. Share only the sanitized details needed to assess the vulnerability.

## Review and disclosure

The maintainer reviews reports through GitHub Security Advisories and may request further details. Confirmed issues may be addressed in maintained code and coordinated for disclosure through GitHub. No fixed response or remediation timeline is promised.

For ordinary bugs and feature requests that are not security vulnerabilities, follow the [contribution guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md) instead.
